The Eiffel Tower

The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower in Paris, France. It was completed in 1889 for the World's Fair. The tower stands 330 metres tall and was the tallest structure in the world at the time.

Gustave Eiffel designed the famous landmark. Millions of visitors climb it every year to enjoy the panoramic view over the whole city.
